

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
```

## load data
```{r}
parks <- st_read("data/parks/PARKRES.shp")
facilities <- read_excel("data/facilities.xlsx")
health <- read_excel(
  "data/Victorian Population Health Survey 2023.xlsx",
  range = "A1:R8911"
)
lga <- st_read("data/LGA/LGA_POLYGON.shp")
```

```{r}
parks_lga <- st_join(
  parks,
  lga |> select(LGA_CODE, LGA_NAME),
  left = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(parks_lga$LGA_NAME))
parks_lga |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  count(PRIMS_ID) |>
  arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}
parks |>
+     st_drop_geometry() |>
+     count(PRIMS_ID, sort = TRUE)
```


```{r}
parks |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(PRIMS_ID) |>
  summarise(
    n_names = n_distinct(NAME),
    names = paste(unique(NAME), collapse = " | "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_names > 1)
```
